approvedExceptions.reason: Chart rendering remains outside canonical GDS component ownership; GDS should own surrounding containers, states, labels, spacing, and actions.
approvedExceptions.allowedImplementation: Use Recharts only for chart plotting internals; wrap chart surfaces, labels, empty states, panels, and actions with GDS primitives.
approvedExceptions.mustStillUse: GDS SectionPanel, StateBlock, PageHeader, SemanticButton, tokens, and locale contracts around all chart surfaces.
approvedExceptions.mustNotDo: Do not introduce chart-specific local design-system tokens, raw UI shells, or non-GDS action controls.
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Replace with a GDS chart primitive when the GDS package ships a compatible charting contract.

approvedExceptions.reason: PDF output uses jsPDF layout primitives and print-specific constraints; GDS should own report action semantics and high-level content hierarchy.
approvedExceptions.allowedImplementation: Use jsPDF and jspdf-autotable only for PDF canvas generation, pagination, embedded fonts, and print-safe export layout.
approvedExceptions.mustStillUse: GDS-governed UI actions, report triggers, dashboard framing, copy, and token-derived brand values before entering PDF generation.
approvedExceptions.mustNotDo: Do not reuse PDF drawing helpers as screen UI components or as a parallel design-system authority.
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Replace or wrap with a GDS report/export primitive when available.

approvedExceptions.reason: News posts are structured localized content, not reusable UI primitives; GDS should own article shell and public surface framing.
approvedExceptions.allowedImplementation: Store localized news content as product-authored structured data and render it through GDS public/article surfaces.
approvedExceptions.mustStillUse: GDS PublicShell, ArticleShell, PageHeader, SectionPanel, and locale filtering for all news rendering.
approvedExceptions.mustNotDo: Do not render a post in a locale unless that post has authored content for that locale.
a11yRequirements: Rendered news pages must preserve ArticleShell landmarks, localized headings, meaningful link text, keyboard-readable publication metadata, and locale-safe fallbacks without hidden untranslated content.
testingRequirements: Run localized news route tests or manual route checks for list/detail pages in each supported locale whenever post structure or rendering changes.
observabilityRequirements: News rendering failures must surface through standard Next.js error logging with route, locale, and slug context; missing localized post content must fail closed by returning notFound instead of rendering partial content.
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Move to a GDS-compatible CMS/content adapter if the GDS package ships one.

approvedExceptions.reason: SSO provider controls may require provider-specific brand constraints while remaining framed by GDS auth shell contracts.
approvedExceptions.allowedImplementation: Keep OAuth protocol, provider redirects, token exchange, and provider-specific identity constraints in service/API code.
approvedExceptions.mustStillUse: GDS AuthShell/SocialAuthButtons where an interactive auth surface is rendered.
approvedExceptions.mustNotDo: Do not create custom unauthenticated app shells or provider buttons when a GDS auth primitive can render the surface.
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Replace provider-specific UI with GDS auth primitives once all required SSO provider states are covered.

approvedExceptions.reason: Print media needs flattened page-safe styles that differ from screen surfaces; exceptions must stay scoped to print/export selectors.
approvedExceptions.allowedImplementation: Use print-only CSS selectors and markup only for browser print/export behavior.
approvedExceptions.mustStillUse: GDS screen surfaces and token-derived layout before the print media boundary.
approvedExceptions.mustNotDo: Do not use print exceptions to style normal interactive application screens.
approvedExceptions.exitCondition: Replace with a GDS print/export layout primitive when available.
